title: 第478章 云氏底蕴恐怖如斯第477章 苦命的师徒二合一
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
第8章云氏底蕴，恐怖如斯
揽云巅。
此峰半在城中，半入天外，峰顶常年云海翻涌，伸手便似可摘九天流云，由是得名。
云氏这一次的九天集会，便设在最高峰——揽云巅。
云擎此时，正负手立于云梦泽之中，眺望着那座最高峰。
沿途所见云梦泽之瑰丽奇幻，即便是云大公子，也不由心生感慨。
仙城九重，云湖万里。
云梦泽，乃是云氏明面上对外开放的无上主城。此城已屹立万古，镇锁一方云脉，为诸天品级最顶尖的超级仙城。
九道先天灵脉绕城环流，街巷玉砖自带聚灵天纹，楼阁飞檐衔星纳月，丹铺器阁、药园商楼、仙舟码头等诸脉产业连绵千万里，往来诸天修士、附庸部族、客卿门客络绎不绝，繁华鼎盛冠绝天元。
但只有天元大陆最顶尖的那一撮人知道，云氏雄霸天元、位列诸天九大巅峰势力，其核心可不在云梦泽。
而是其后万古云海深处，那片藏于千重云峰之间，不动如山的云氏祖地。
那里是云氏宗祠以及诸长老闭关隐修之地，是云氏真正的底蕴所在。寻常族人、外客、附属势力，轻易不得踏入。
如果说云梦泽能解决世间九成九的风波事端。
而当云梦泽也镇压不住时，就会往后摇人。
届时，族地深处那些平日里闭关喝茶、养剑炼丹、睡觉装死的宿老们，便会抓阄踢一个倒霉蛋出来把麻烦摆平。
也正因内外分层、表里藏锋，外人一辈子踏遍云梦泽，也难窥云氏真正底蕴的冰山一角。
而这般繁华万古的顶级仙城，年方二十的云擎，竟是第一次静下心来细细打量。
他自年少便身负重任，奔波不休，大半岁月要么在内闭关，要么在外征战，族地少驻，主城更是少游，偌大云梦泽，于他而言竟形同陌路。
所以为何此前对云梦泽并无太多描写——
咳，只能怪年方二十出头的云大公子，他连云氏族地都没正经待过几年，更别提来云梦泽了。

别问，问就是活得少的错。
于是此时此刻，云擎与云渊并肩立在云梦泽主城最繁华的一条云街之上，抬眸望着满目云海仙楼、仙桥云轨、车马仙舟往来不绝的盛景，眼底难掩真切的感慨。
只见眼前云气常年不散，楼阁悬浮于云水之间，仙桥横跨湖天，白鹤成群，灵舟如织。
更高处，几座仙楼半隐半现，楼外悬着“百草丹府”“天璇器坊”“南山灵植行”“虚渊旧书楼”等等牌匾。
云擎看了片刻，道：“原来云梦泽是这般模样。”

云擎侧眸。

content_en:
Chapter 8 Yun’s background is so terrifying
Reach the top of the clouds.
This peak is half in the city and half in the sky. The sea of ​​clouds billows all year round at the top of the peak. It seems that you can pick up the clouds from the sky with your hand, hence the name.
The Yun family's nine-day gathering this time was held at the highest peak - Mount Lanyun.
At this time, Yun Qing was standing in the Yunmeng Lake with his hands behind his back, looking at the highest peak.
The magnificent and fantastic Yunmeng Ze seen along the way made even Mr. Yun unable to help but feel emotional.
The fairy city has nine levels, and the clouds and lakes are thousands of miles away.
Yunmengze is the supreme main city of the Yun family that is open to the outside world. This city has stood for eternity, anchoring a cloud vein, and is the top-notch super fairy city in the world.
Nine innate spiritual veins circulate around the city, the jade bricks in the streets and lanes have their own spiritual-gathering sky patterns, the eaves of the pavilions hold the stars and the moon, and various industries such as Danpu Qi Pavilion, Yaoyuan Commercial Building, Xianzhou Wharf, etc. stretch for thousands of miles. There is an endless stream of monks, vassal tribes, and guests from all over the world. The prosperity is the highest in Tianyuan.
But only the top group of people in Tianyuan Continent know that the Yun family dominates Tianyuan and ranks among the nine top powers in the world, and its core is not in Yunmengze.
But in the depths of the eternal sea of ​​clouds, the ancestral land of the Yun family is hidden among thousands of cloud peaks and remains as motionless as a mountain.
There is the Yun family's ancestral hall and the place where the elders go into seclusion. It is the true heritage of the Yun family. Ordinary tribesmen, foreigners, and affiliated forces are not allowed to enter easily.
If Yun Mengze can solve 99% of the troubles in the world.
And when Yun Mengze couldn't suppress it, he would shake him back.
At that time, the elders deep in the clan who usually spend their days in seclusion drinking tea, raising swords and refining elixirs, and pretending to be dead while sleeping, will draw lots and kick an unlucky guy out to settle the trouble.
It is precisely because of the internal and external layers and the hidden frontiers between the outside and the outside that it is difficult for outsiders to get a glimpse of the true heritage of the Yun family even if they spend their entire lives traveling around Yunmengze.
It was the first time for twenty-year-old Yun Qing to calm down and take a closer look at such a prosperous and top-notch fairy city.
He has been burdened with heavy responsibilities since he was young and has been traveling endlessly. For most of his years, he was either in seclusion or fighting abroad. He rarely stayed in the clan area and rarely visited the main city. The huge Yunmengze was like a stranger to him.
So why hasn’t there been much description of Yun Mengze before——
Well, I can only blame Mr. Yun, who is in his early twenties. He has not even stayed in the Yun clan for a few years, let alone come to Yunmengze.
Don't ask, asking is the fault of living less.
So at this moment, Yun Qing and Yun Yuan stood side by side on the most prosperous Cloud Street in the main city of Yunmengze. They looked up at the grand scene of Yunhai Fairy Tower, Fairy Bridge, Cloud Rail, and Cars, Horses and Fairy Boats, and they could not hide the real emotion in their eyes.
I saw clouds lingering in front of me all year round, pavilions suspended between clouds and water, fairy bridges spanning the lake and sky, white cranes in groups, and spiritual boats like weavings.
Higher up, several fairy towers are half hidden and half visible. Outside the buildings are hanging plaques such as "Baicao Danfu", "Tianxuan Qifang", "Nanshan Lingzhi Store", "Xuyuan Old Library" and so on.
Yun Qing looked at it for a moment and said, "So Yun Mengze looks like this."

Yun Yuan turned his head and looked at his moved expression, and couldn't help but laugh: "Boy, there are many more magnificent worlds and sects that you have never seen before."
Yun Qing glanced sideways.
